scope: Evaluate men's J1 with the complete original R5 population and R7 calendars. Fit before 2024-01-01, select three head doses in 2024, evaluate 2025 (380 original slots) and separately 2026/27 through the original latest date (150). Retain the registered stages, regulation labels and missing markets. Do not use a current target's eventual lineup, injury status, substitutions or minutes as inputs.
raw_rosters: Join an original ESPN summary to the R5 event ID, named league and ordered team IDs, original schedule date, final regulation status and goals. Identifiers must be unique for exactly 11 actual starters per side with the provider starter flag true. Group G and D as defence, M and F as attack; unknown or ambiguous positions are missing for that side. Archive availability per event and separate team sides. Only strictly earlier dates may supply a roster or label. Retrospectively retrieved finished-match rosters support a within-history reconstruction; quote clocks and prospectively known lineups are separate.
anchor: For every source match use that same row's chronological R7 input anchor, before fitting any R15 weight, to form home and away expected goals. At the end of a whole source date append side-specific attack/concession residuals actual goals minus expected goals, clipped to [-3,3]. Player keys are stable professional IDs within that team. All windows are calendar dates, not elapsed kickoff hours.
form_control: Use each club's last six actual registered J1 appearances in the previous 90 days, including those without rosters, and divide total attacking/concession residuals by 4+n. For a scoring side the two control features are own attack and opposite concession. Clip to [-1,1].
lineup_features: For each side use its immediately preceding J1 match within 90 days as the projected starting group. If its original lineup is missing, leave both personnel features for that club at zero. For each projected attacking M/F or defending G/D player, look back 365 days before the target across all that club's registered games. Compute its group-appropriate residual sum minus (number of starts times the club's average residual over the same complete 365-day club schedule), divided by number of starts plus 8. Average across that projected group. The other personnel feature is the fraction of the immediately preceding match's group that also started in that group in the immediately previous J1 appearance, minus 0.75. Both appearances must be within 90 days; a missing intervening roster stays a missing slot. Clip each final component to [-1,1]. The six columns for each scoring side are own attack form, opponent concession form, own projected attack rating, opponent projected defensive concession rating, own attack retention and opponent defence retention.
estimation: Use the registered R14 two-hurdle objective, ridge 24, bounded coefficients and row/column probability adjustment, with R7's chronological input anchors for training. Fit a two-column form-only and a six-column form+personnel model independently. Select doses on the fixed 2024 validation calendar using R10's score-first/score-three/log-loss tie break, independent WDL and actual-OU heads. Compare published R7, R10, market, form-only at optimised and equal doses, and fixed full-dose models. All weights, labels, market lines and flows inherit the original chronological folds. Totals require real historical lines; no substitution with a conventional 2.5.
ranking: In each original held-out scope use every competition calendar-day batch, including short batches. Rank candidate fixtures by their actual chosen first-score probability descending, then original fixture ID. Report each of three seats, all-three-first-hit sweeps, eligible full and short batches, plus individual first and ordered-three hit rates. Keep all days even if every candidate ties its control. Historical selection is a retrospective experiment. Prospective slates must lock before their earliest kickoff using the original source clock; started fixtures and earlier user-visible selections retain their original status.
comparison: Record paired gained/lost/net and matchday-clustered 95% intervals against R7 and form-only, min and missingness by source and fold. Distinguish coverage by attack or defence group, both complete rosters, and all neutral. Only full scheduled-population actual pre-issued and displayed observations count for stage certification. A working time split or a historical gain alone cannot promote an active model.
